headline: Keep {arm:September}. Both candidates increase cost while reducing character adherence.
lede: {arm:September} achieves the highest pass rate at {pass_rate.September|pct} with the lowest production cost of {cost_per_1k.September|usd_per_1k}. A candidate would need to demonstrate both lower cost and superior character preservation to justify a migration.

slots.text: Retain {arm:September} in production. It leads character adherence at {pass_rate.September|pct} and incurs the lowest cost at {cost_per_1k.September|usd_per_1k}.

{arm:1017} drops {reading.1017.change|abs|pts} points ({reading.1017.interval|pts}) and costs {cost_per_1k.1017|usd_per_1k}; {arm:qwen3.8-flash} drops {reading.qwen3.8-flash.change|abs|pts} points ({reading.qwen3.8-flash.interval|pts}) and costs {cost_per_1k.qwen3.8-flash|usd_per_1k}.

{weakest.arm} sits closest to the margin at {weakest.value|pts} against {weakest.threshold|pts}, leaving a gap of {weakest.margin|pts}. Confounding shifts in reasoning share and simulator settings qualify candidate regressions; two runs of {arm:qwen3.8-flash} dropped one cell each to infra errors. A prior insight that {arm:qwen3.8-flash} lowers production cost is contradicted by observed spend.
Test {arm:1017} with reasoning effort matched to {arm:September} to isolate whether character drops stem from model weights or budget truncation.

caveats.material_if: The aspect was confirmed after launch; material only if character adherence was chosen to disadvantage the challengers.
The control assignment was designated after run start; material only if another variant was the baseline.
The judge is uncalibrated; material only if judge bias systematically favors {arm:September} over the challenger models.

method.text: {cases} distinct cases were evaluated with {repeats} repeats per arm, yielding {scoreboard.September.usable} usable trials for {arm:September}.
A trial passes when persona and execution checks hold, including character adherence criteria.
Aspect readings use confirmatory intervals at {family.level} corrected level; contrast families apply Holm correction.
The judge model is {judge.model} operating at tier {judge.tier} with {judge.calibration} calibration.
Simulator request settings were not recorded across every run, leaving user conversation execution unverified.
Input tokens, output tokens, and llm calls were unmetered in telemetry; spend reflects reported cost.

sections.headline: Both candidates hold within the margin but trail {arm:September}
sections.takeaway: Confidence intervals show both models regress within the permitted {aspect.margin|int}-point margin.

explore.title: Decision sensitivity
explore.recomputes: No margin setting alters the decision because {arm:September} dominates on both adherence and cost; {arm:1017} breaks margin below {flip_margin.1017|pts} and {arm:qwen3.8-flash} breaks below {flip_margin.qwen3.8-flash|pts}.

durable_claims.text: {arm:qwen3.8-flash} increases production replicating cost relative to {arm:September} from {cost_per_1k.September|usd_per_1k} to {cost_per_1k.qwen3.8-flash|usd_per_1k} (delta {contrast.qwen3.8-flash.production_replicating_cost.delta|usd}).

Both {arm:1017} and {arm:qwen3.8-flash} regress on character adherence against {arm:September} by {contrast.1017.persona.holds_character.delta|pts} and {contrast.qwen3.8-flash.persona.holds_character.delta|pts} points respectively.
